name: where-is-my-books
description: Где мои книги — монолит: NestJS + React + TypeScript + MobX + PostgreSQL

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: npm run dev:db && concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && npm run start
